name: pre-release-shapes
instruction: Review the target file for compatibility machinery that preserves retired airimayor contracts. Read root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, and the current reader, writer, or schema at issue. The product has not shipped: persisted data with an unknown shape must be rejected clearly; current writers should emit one current shape. Report migrations, old-field aliases, old tool-name aliases, alternate historical schemas, and successful defaults that silently reinterpret an unsupported stored shape when you can demonstrate that they serve an old product contract. Identify the actual shapes or names and their path through the implementation. Missing optional current fields, an explicitly defined empty state, validated current caches, provider protocol versions, supported external SDK formats, test fixtures, and localization fallback are not evidence of pre-release compatibility. In particular, a framework option such as legacy: false disables a framework mode rather than accepting old product data. Do not infer a released compatibility requirement or user authorization from hypothetical users. Attach concrete findings to target lines; report no finding without evidence of a retired or unknown product shape being accepted.
